text:
hua: Quick note from the onboarding sample smoke tests: we triggered duplicated side-effects when a 429 coincided with token rotation + immediate resend. Minimal repro below.

hua: Repro steps: 1) start a streaming POST to /v1/chat, 2) token TTL expires mid-stream, 3) next write returns 429, 4) SDK refreshes and immediately resends the same payload, 5) server processes both -> duplicate.

nate: bummer. do we have a shared op id across the stream? sample currently emits per-frame ids so retries look fresh.

hua: yep, per-frame uuids today. also refresh path currently does no jitter so it blind-retries straight away.

alix: two-layer plan: short-term sampleapp mitigations + long-term SDK parity. Short-term: add stable header `X-RW-Op-Id` on stream start and reuse on retries; also opt-in `Idempotency-Key` for mutating calls.

alix: I propose server keep a tiny LRU set for op ids for 60s and return 409 or `X-RW-Dedupe-Result: duplicate` when seen. Document TTL and a clamp for Idempotency-Expiry.

nate: for SDKs: change refresh-path retry to full jitter and expose a setOperationId() hook for streams. Suggested jitter: base=200ms; sleep = random(0, min(base * 2**attempt, 10000)). cap 10s.

hua: sampleapp snippet (node):
```
const opId = uuidv4();
fetch('/v1/streams/chat', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
    'X-RW-Op-Id': opId
  }
});
// when retrying a chunk after refresh include opId in the envelope
```

alix: also tested a Replay-Nonce idea: before resending after a refresh, send a lightweight HEAD /v1/replay-check with headers `X-RW-Op-Id` + `X-RW-Frame-Hash`. Server replies 200=ok or 409=seen. This is opt-in and avoids keeping long server state for some customers.

nate: replay-handshake is neat but adds an extra round trip. good as an opt-in advanced mode. default should be op-id + jitter + server LRU.

hua: pasted sanitized logs showing the dup: 
```
[2026-05-04T18:02:03Z] biz_evt=order-77 status=202 chunk=12
[2026-05-04T18:03:18Z] biz_evt=order-77 status=429 note="auth-refresh"
[2026-05-04T18:03:18Z] client: token-refresh start
[2026-05-04T18:03:18Z] client: retry chunk new-token biz_evt=order-77
[2026-05-04T18:03:20Z] biz_evt=order-77 status=200 processed
```

alix: QA plan: add deterministic harness that forces token TTL to expire mid-stream and asserts at-most-once server-side action. Add interop tests across node/python/java/go. Also add an opt-in response header `X-RW-Dedupe-Result: accepted|duplicate|expired` for easier debugging.

nate: CI: opened RW-83421 to track SDK parity and canary. Canaries must run node/python/java/go matrix and include the deterministic harness. schedule: canary slot 02:00 UTC tomorrow.

hua: docs: I'll add a short onboarding note explaining X-RW-Op-Id, Idempotency-Expiry header (seconds), and the Replay-Nonce opt-in flow. Include example server dedupe TTL values and recommended caps.

alix: security/ops note: keep LRU bounded and clamp max expiry to protect memory. For customers requiring long windows, recommend storing idempotency state in customer-managed store (Private deployments).

infra-bot: RW-83421 created: "devex: op-id + refresh-jitter + replay-handshake parity and sampleapp harness" assigned to @nate.

ci-bot: RW-83421 queued for canary. Reminder: any auth/retry change needs cross-language tests and a rollback plan.

nate: action items: 1) hua - sampleapp PR to add X-RW-Op-Id + test harness, 2) nate - SDK PR to add refresh-path full jitter + setOperationId() across SDKs, 3) alix - doc + server dedupe guidance + replay-handshake prototype. I'll post PRs and ping for reviews. :mag: :shipit:
